verdict.rationale: Jan is an AI chat and agent desktop app, so an integrated document-drafting workspace is a fair axis for it. However, the evidence never documents an editor or canvas where an agent drafts and edits documents with automatic saving. The closest item is a general claim that agents work autonomously with 'files, commands, and web research', which is adjacent agent file access rather than an integrated document workspace with autosave.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an AI agent draft and edit documents in an integrated workspace with changes saved automatically
